# Curious Monkey Media (Curious Monkey Media Montreal)

> Curious Monkey Media is a digital marketing agency serving all of Montreal, in every region of the city, and Greater Montreal, founded by Daniel Yoskovitch (graduate of the John Molson School of Business, Concordia University). It helps small businesses, clinics and independent professionals attract qualified leads and turn them into customers. All services are offered in English and French.

Note: Curious Monkey Media Montreal (curious-monkeymedia.ca) is a Montreal marketing agency. It is not the same as, and is not affiliated with, the YouTube photography and Steadicam channel that uses a similar name.

## Services
- Social media management: content strategy, on-site filming, reels, photography, captions and scheduled posts for Instagram and Facebook.
- Content creation: reels, short videos and photography filmed at the client's business, for social media, websites and ads.
- Website design and management: clean, fast, bilingual websites built to bring calls, bookings and enquiries, with ongoing updates after launch.
- SEO and local visibility: local SEO and Google Business Profile setup.
- Video production: promo videos, reels, testimonial and brand videos filmed on site anywhere in Montreal, in English and French.
- Also offered: Meta (Facebook and Instagram) advertising, digital business consulting, brand identity and print design, email and SMS marketing.

## Who it works with
Clinics, local businesses, independent professionals and companies across a variety of industries.

## Service area
All of Montreal, Quebec, Canada, in every region of the city: downtown, the West Island, the East End, and the north and south of the island. Also Greater Montreal (Laval, Longueuil, the South Shore and the North Shore). Service-area business with no public office; meetings by Google Meet, phone or on site.

## How to start
A free 30-minute consultation by Google Meet or phone: https://calendar.app.google/TDFeHMnXmwJy3zsY6
Work runs month to month with no minimum contract. Clients own every account, file and piece of content created for them.

## Hours
Monday to Thursday 9 AM to 5 PM, Friday 9 AM to 3 PM, Saturday closed, Sunday 10 AM to 1 PM (Eastern Time).

## FAQ
- How do I start? Book a free 30-minute call; you leave with one clear recommendation whether or not you work together.
- Is there a minimum contract? No. Month to month; most clients begin with a fixed-fee trial project.
- Can I start with one service? Yes, most clients do.
- Who owns the accounts and content? The client, always.
- Do you work in French? Yes, fully bilingual (English and French).
- Do you have an office? No public office; filming happens on site at the client's business, meetings by Google Meet, phone or in person anywhere in Montreal.

## Registration
Registered in Quebec as Agence Curious Monkey Media (sole proprietorship), Quebec Enterprise Number (NEQ) 2282618083.
